transcript:
Meeting Header:
Date: 2026-12-01
Start: 10:00 AM PST
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees: Ari, Mina, Owen, Diego, Leah, Sofia, Jonah and ~80 others (all-hands)

Auto Summary (auto-generated):
- Quick product/ops update: infra stable, tail latency down 12% month-over-month, a couple of customer-facing incidents in November that triggered postmortems.
- People: hiring still behind plan but offer acceptance improving; parents leave/comp time update.
- Leadership asks: simplify on-call & clarify Dedicated pricing messaging for field.

-- Transcript --
[00:00] Ari Holtz: Hey everyone, uh, welcome to the December all-hands. We'll run about an hour. Thanks for joining, lots to cover. Mina, take it away for product and priorities?
[00:18] Mina Patel: Thanks Ari. Uh, hi team. Quick overview, two things up front — Q4 delivery on the Compile+KV revamp is green, we shipped the continuous batching improvement, and that already shows up in throughput on internal benchmarks. There's also a small regression with the big-prompt paths that Diego flagged yesterday, so devteam is working a mitigation.
[00:40] Diego Ramirez: yeah sorry to jump in, the regen on long-contexts was from a kernel selection mismatch; it's not pervasive but it can increase tail latency. Patch in staging, will push tonight.
[00:53] Owen Park: Just to add — the runtime picks kernels dynamically, and sometimes the heuristics choose a less-quant friendly path for longer contexts. We're tweaking that logic and adding a guardrail.
[01:08] Audience: [laughter / applause emoji reactions]
[01:15] Mina Patel: Okay, other priorities — Dedicated pricing clarity, we've heard from sales that the messaging is confusing when to push Dedicated versus Hosted. Jonah, can you briefly restate the ask?
[01:30] Jonah Kim: Sure, field wants a one-pager: practical rules of thumb — latency-sensitive > 100 RPS or sustained token throughput, data residency/air-gapped, or enterprise compliance reasons => Dedicated; otherwise start Hosted. Also include cost band examples.
[01:48] Mina Patel: Great. We'll make that and circulate.
[01:52] Leah Chen: On people — hiring pulse: offer acceptance is trending up 7% since Oct, but still below target. We're prioritizing senior infra and platform folks. Also reminder about the new parental leave top-up policy — it's live in Workday.
[02:08] Ari Holtz: thanks Leah. Any questions on people?
[02:13] [Silence / chat reactions]
[02:20] Mina Patel: Shifting back to reliability — Diego and Owen, want to show a short slide with SLOs? (Note: slide deck shared: link to drive / internal doc)
[02:30] Owen Park: Sure, quick numbers: overall 99.9% availability for hosted models this quarter, median latency down 18% for small-gen, tail p95 improved, but we had two incidents — one was the kernel mismatch Diego mentioned, second was a KV cache eviction bug that surfaced in a high-concurrency POC.
[02:52] Diego Ramirez: For the KV issue the eviction heuristic mis-estimated prefix re-use; fix in canary now. The incident write-up is in the incident board (link shared).
[03:06] Mina Patel: There's a pattern — these are both around long-lived sessions and on-prem workloads. Might need a dedicated regression test focus.
[03:16] Audience Member (Speaker 1): Quick question — for Private customers with stricter compliance, is there any change to the audit log retention?
[03:26] Owen Park: Good Q. Audit retention for Private is configurable; no change today but we are adding hooks for immutable logs tied to KMS later in Q1.
[03:36] Speaker 2 (Sales): On Dedicated pricing, we've heard competitor comparisons where they eat initial infra costs. Can we give field an example with numbers?
[03:46] Mina Patel: Yes, we'll add a simple worked example: 3 model variants, commit size 8x GPUs, and show monthly unit economics relative to hosted. Jonah to own.
[03:55] Jonah Kim: Yep will do.
[03:58] [04:00] Leah Chen: Back to culture — reminder about the winter offsite sign-up, and we're testing a new async recognition channel for peer kudos. Please submit nominations for the engineering awards by Friday.
[04:13] Ari Holtz: I want to call out cross-team hiring — Carlos' infra team closed three roles this month, great work. Also an ask: simplify on-call. We've had a few long wake-ups and the rota is complex.
[04:30] Owen Park: Proposed change: move from 7-day heavy rotation to a lightweight 24/7 pager primary + secondary model, with escalation to SRE on-call only for platform incidents. We'll draft a runbook and pilot in January.
[04:46] Diego Ramirez: We'll keep follow-the-sun for critical on-call but reduce paging noise via filtering rules; the team asked for fewer context switches so devs can ship.
[04:58] Mina Patel: Okay let's be explicit — deliverables: Owen + Diego to draft updated rota and runbook; Leah to coordinate on-call compensation and burnout measures.
[05:12] Audience Member (Speaker 3): Will the new rota change paging for Dedicated customers?
[05:18] Owen Park: For Dedicated we'll maintain a separate escalation path for the customer success/SRE liaison. Operational SLAs won't change; just internal paging adjustments.
[05:28] Mina Patel: Quick state of OKRs — we hit 73% of Q4 outcomes on track, a few reds in hiring and enterprise sales pipeline. Sofia, you want to say a quick word?
[05:40] Sofia Martinez: Sales pipeline: enterprise motion picked up two new pilots with regulated customers; we need security docs for one of them — SSO/SAML and SOC 2 copy. Security pack is being updated by the security team, will share tomorrow.
[05:54] Mina Patel: Great, thanks.
[06:00] Audience Segment — Live Q&A (hand raised)
[06:05] Speaker 4: Any updates on open source contributions and model cataloging?
[06:11] Mina Patel: Yes, the model catalog now has metadata tagging and a verified-performance flag. We're going to push a short guide on how to onboard models with the catalog.
[06:23] Speaker 5: Clarify: is the verified-performance test public?
[06:28] Diego Ramirez: Not public for now — it's internal benchmarking; we'll create a public facing summary soon.
[06:34] Mina Patel: Okay last formal thing — budget and runway check. Finance ran a light forecast; runway is healthy through next 18 months with planed hiring. We will still prudently pace hires.
[06:47] Ari Holtz: Closing notes — big thank you. Recap of asks: micro-roadmap (Mina), simplify on-call runbook (Owen+Diego), hiring dashboard (Leah), Dedicated pricing one-pager (Jonah). We'll follow up in #all-hands-notes with links.
[07:03] Mina Patel: One more quick cultural ask — please use the new async recognition, it helps people feel seen.
[07:10] Leah Chen: Also reminder, holiday time off guidance posted.
[07:15] Ari Holtz: Alright, thanks everyone. We'll post slides and the recorded video. End.

-- End Transcript --
